unit: Unit 1: Number Systems, Boolean Algebra, Logic Gates, Canonical Forms & K-Map Minimization
Unit 2: Combinational Logic Design: Adders, Subtractors, Decoders, Encoders, Multiplexers, De-MUX, Comparators
Unit 3: Sequential Logic: Latches, Flip-Flops (SR, JK, D, T), Master-Slave Operation, Race-around Condition
Unit 4: Registers, Synchronous & Asynchronous Counters, Finite State Machine (FSM) Design (Mealy & Moore)
Unit 5: Logic Families (TTL, CMOS), Semiconductor Memories (ROM, RAM, SRAM, DRAM, PLA, PAL, FPGA Intro)
